jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Backend Engineer | Seed-Stage Sports Fintech

NYC Onsite | $200k + Equity

DevLogic has partnered exclusively with a seed-funded startup in New York building a consumer investment platform in the sports space.

They're hiring their first full-time backend engineer to own the core of the platform.

The company

Seed round closed, backed by investors from the world of professional sport
Regulated by the SEC, after an approval process that took over six months. That's a barrier most competitors won't get past.
Built-in network effects: once fans and athletes are on the platform, there's little reason to leave
Not an AI company. They use AI to build, but the product is about sport and real money, a market that keeps growing whatever happens to the AI hype cycle
Live with real users and real athletes signed

The role

You'll own the backend. You'll work directly with the CTO, who has built across consumer, B2B SaaS and fintech. Nobody will hand you a ticket list. The expectation is that you decide what matters most, explain why, and see it through from start to finish.

What you'll work on

Designing the backend architecture as the platform scales
Building the systems that move customer money from their bank into escrow with regulated partners
Making sure every dollar is tracked correctly, with nothing lost or double-counted
Fraud prevention, and making sure legal records are signed and attributed to the right people
Integrations with brokerage, banking and transfer agent partners

Stack:
TypeScript and Node.js. If your background is Python, Go, Java or similar, that's fine. Strong backend fundamentals matter more than the language.

What they're looking for

4+ years of backend or software development experience
You've built and owned a serious backend system, not just one small piece of it
Experience integrating with third-party APIs, ideally financial ones
Fintech experience (payments, brokerage, ledgers, money movement) is a big plus but not a must
A clear communicator who's comfortable working directly with founders
A genuine interest in sport, or at least real curiosity about the space

You don't need to have worked at an early-stage startup. If you're at a mid-stage company or in big tech and want your work to actually move the business, this is worth a look.

What to expect

45 to 55 hours a week depending on the week. It's not a 996 culture, but the team moves quickly.
No hand-holding. You'll have a lot of ownership from day one.
Office in NYC Onsite

Compensation

$200,000 base salary
Founding-level equity

Why I'm excited about this one

I've spent a lot of time with the founding team. They're building something that gets real money into the hands of up-and-coming athletes and lets fans share in the upside of the sport they already spend their money on. It's one of the few early-stage products I've seen this year that doesn't rely on AI to justify itself.

I'm running this search exclusively, so every application comes straight to me and I'll reply to everyone personally.

If you'd like to know more before applying, message me directly (Aiden @ devlogic)

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (CB2C085)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a consumer fintech platform offering lending and payment experiences to people seeking short-term finance. It is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build and operate production software using AI coding agents, while retaining personal responsibility for the architecture and quality of what ships.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a people-management position. You'll direct agents across frontend, backend and infrastructure work, turning product requirements into executable tasks and reviewing the results before they reach customers. Knowing when to intervene or write the code yourself is as important as knowing how to delegate work to an agent.

You'll work with Product and Design on delivery, and own the controls that make agent-assisted development dependable: tests, evaluation harnesses, code review, deployment gates and production monitoring. The opportunity is to shape the development workflow as well as the applications it produces.

The Role

Deliver full-stack features across consumer financial products, taking responsibility for interfaces, APIs, services and data layers.
Orchestrate AI agents from specification through pull requests and deployment, verifying and integrating their output.
Design workflows, prompts, guardrails and evaluation standards for production coding, testing and review.
Build CI checks and review gates that keep generated code secure, correct and auditable.
Make architecture decisions and maintain application performance, reliability and security end to end.
Monitor system health and incidents, bringing human judgement to situations agents cannot safely resolve.

What We're Looking For

At least six years of full-stack engineering experience delivering production systems.
Strong frontend skills in React or a similar framework, alongside backend APIs and services, databases and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience directing AI coding agents or LLM-based workflows in production, beyond experimentation.
Sound testing, code review, security and deployment practices, with evidence of systems you've shipped and can explain in depth.
The judgement to operate independently, check agent output critically and take ownership of production outcomes.

Useful Background

Fintech, lending or payments experience is useful, as are mobile development skills in React Native or native iOS/Android. Experience building CI/CD, observability or evaluation systems for agent pipelines would also be relevant.

This could suit a senior or staff-level product engineer who already uses agents in production and wants to combine broad technical ownership with disciplined, hands-on delivery.

T2 Systems is the largest parking, mobility, and transportation provider in North America, with more than 25 years in the parking management industry and currently serving thousands of parking professionals. Participates in agile development teams to build and maintain software solutions for the parking industry.
Contributes to all stages of the software development lifecycle.
Collaborates with team members to break down work, estimate effort, and deliver value within sprint commitments.
Works in a fast-paced environment and contributes to improvements in tooling, automation, development, and testing practices.
Interacts with product owners and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and clarify business needs.
Contributes to technical design discussions and code reviews.
Works closely with other departments to develop solutions that solve business problems and benefit customers.
Produces high-quality, tested software enhancements and bug fixes.

jobs.description:
About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team

The Information Technology department is core to the health and growth of Millennium’s business. The firm’s active, multi-manager model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. The Fixed Income Applications development team builds and supports a pricing engine used by more than 300 portfolio teams, covering a broad range of financial products (bonds, futures, options, FX spots/forwards, deposits, swaps, commodities, swaptions, CDX, CDS, equities, etc). As a result, this team supports both live streaming and ETL data providers, as well as downstream distribution to analytics, risk, and trader systems (such as analytics, risk, and trader systems).

Team members interact directly with business users and other technology teams, so solid communication skills are essential. The team owns the entire software lifecycle, from requirements and design, through implementation, to production releases and support. Release cycles are tight, so in addition to strong development skills, you must have demonstrated the ability to adapt to changing conditions and learn quickly.

We are looking for an experienced player/coach who can liaise with business users and our support team to help work out functional and technical requirements, while balancing efforts across product silos and build-out vs clearing technical debt or bugs. The role requires being able to provide leadership/mentoring on some work while being an individual contributor on other items. There are no business analysts on the team, so we expect developers to have the ability to learn or have sufficient business and product knowledge to understand the requirements on their own. That said, this is not a quantitative role – there is a separate analytics team that undertakes valuation and related work.

What You'll Do

Build, enhance, and support a pricing engine used across the firm’s fixed income platform
Deliver solutions across a wide range of financial products, including bonds, futures, options, FX, swaps, commodities, and credit products
Partner directly with business users, support teams, and technology stakeholders to define functional and technical requirements
Own the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through production release and support
Balance delivery across product silos while managing technical debt, bug fixes, and platform improvements
Provide leadership and mentorship on selected initiatives while contributing directly as an individual contributor on others
Cover integration of live streaming from vendors like Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc. for distribution to downstream analytics, risk, and trading systems
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and tight release cycles in a fast-moving development environment

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years experience working within the Java
Experience developing against relational databases
Strong project management skills and a proven ability to collaborate across a broad range of domains and stakeholder groups
Experience with event streaming like Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. and distributed caching like Hazelcast, REDIS, Memcached, etc.
Experience working with end users on requirements definition
Experience working as mentor within teams either as functional or technical lead, formally or informally
Financial markets knowledge in at least one product area, such as fixed income, commodities, or derivatives

Salary Range

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, RL Post-Training Frameworks
jobs.description:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL, Miles, and TorchTitan, to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch. Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What You Will Be Doing

You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. This means tuning RL training-inference-rollout loops on GPUs, CPUs, and LPUs for performance where it matters, contributing to and improving the performance and usability of open-source RL frameworks, and partnering with the teams who own them. The role also spans fault tolerance, elastic scaling, and fast restarts so long-running distributed training jobs survive failures, stragglers, and resource contention.

Beyond GPU-accelerated training, this work includes partnering with teams building CPU-driven rollout workloads, including tool-use, code execution, and agentic environments, supplying the systems and framework engineering needed to run them efficiently alongside GPU- or LPU-accelerated generation and GPU-accelerated training. It also means advocating for researcher and partner needs with NVIDIA's networking, math library, and compiler teams so the capabilities RL workloads require get prioritized and delivered, and working with hardware teams to take advantage of next-generation hardware capabilities in post-training workloads.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
5+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, high-performance computing, deep learning infrastructure, or ML systems engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++
Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale distributed systems or runtime frameworks in production at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or major technology company
Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries

Depth in one or more of the following technical areas:

Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling), including how algorithms map to distributed execution and the systems challenges they create (heterogeneous placement, rollouts, environment execution, resharding between training and generation)
PyTorch internals, including distributed training primitives (FSDP, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism) and their composition
Kubernetes runtime internals (container lifecycle, pod scheduling, resource quotas, GPU allocation)
End-to-end distributed systems design (service boundaries, data flows, consistency models, failure modes, recovery approaches)

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

Deep expertise in networking (NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand), advanced multi-dimensional parallelisms (Megatron-LM, FSDP2, TP/DP/PP, MoE), or memory optimizations (quantization-aware training, mixed precision)
Experience integrating high-performance inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) into RL training loops for GPU-accelerated rollout
Strong background in actor- and task-based distributed programming (Ray, Monarch, or comparable systems)
Familiarity with multi-turn training, multi-agent co-evolution, or VLM post-training

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Open-source contributions to RL post-training or distributed training projects (e.g., VeRL, Miles, TorchTitan, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, DeepSpeed-Chat), including significant work on framework internals where applicable
Kubernetes work beyond routine operations (custom operators, GPU device plugins, or scheduling contributions)
Direct experience operating frontier-scale training (RL post-training at thousands of GPUs and/or large-scale LLM or multimodal pre-training)
Hands-on experience with production distributed failures at scale (stragglers, resource contention, hardware faults)

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 25, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team

The Information Technology department is core to the health and growth of Millennium’s business. The firm’s active, multi-manager model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. The Fixed Income Applications development team builds and supports a pricing engine used by more than 300 portfolio teams, covering a broad range of financial products (bonds, futures, options, FX spots/forwards, deposits, swaps, commodities, swaptions, CDX, CDS, equities, etc). As a result, this team supports both live streaming and ETL data providers, as well as downstream distribution to analytics, risk, and trader systems (such as analytics, risk, and trader systems).

Team members interact directly with business users and other technology teams, so solid communication skills are essential. The team owns the entire software lifecycle, from requirements and design, through implementation, to production releases and support. Release cycles are tight, so in addition to strong development skills, you must have demonstrated the ability to adapt to changing conditions and learn quickly.

We are looking for an experienced player/coach who can liaise with business users and our support team to help work out functional and technical requirements, while balancing efforts across product silos and build-out vs clearing technical debt or bugs. The role requires being able to provide leadership/mentoring on some work while being an individual contributor on other items. There are no business analysts on the team, so we expect developers to have the ability to learn or have sufficient business and product knowledge to understand the requirements on their own. That said, this is not a quantitative role – there is a separate analytics team that undertakes valuation and related work.

What You'll Do

Build, enhance, and support a pricing engine used across the firm’s fixed income platform
Deliver solutions across a wide range of financial products, including bonds, futures, options, FX, swaps, commodities, and credit products
Partner directly with business users, support teams, and technology stakeholders to define functional and technical requirements
Own the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through production release and support
Balance delivery across product silos while managing technical debt, bug fixes, and platform improvements
Provide leadership and mentorship on selected initiatives while contributing directly as an individual contributor on others
Cover integration of live streaming from vendors like Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc. for distribution to downstream analytics, risk, and trading systems
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and tight release cycles in a fast-moving development environment

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years experience working within the Java
Experience developing against relational databases
Strong project management skills and a proven ability to collaborate across a broad range of domains and stakeholder groups
Experience with event streaming like Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. and distributed caching like Hazelcast, REDIS, Memcached, etc.
Experience working with end users on requirements definition
Experience working as mentor within teams either as functional or technical lead, formally or informally
Financial markets knowledge in at least one product area, such as fixed income, commodities, or derivatives

Salary Range

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, RL Post-Training Frameworks
new_jobs.description:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL, Miles, and TorchTitan, to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch. Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What You Will Be Doing

You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. This means tuning RL training-inference-rollout loops on GPUs, CPUs, and LPUs for performance where it matters, contributing to and improving the performance and usability of open-source RL frameworks, and partnering with the teams who own them. The role also spans fault tolerance, elastic scaling, and fast restarts so long-running distributed training jobs survive failures, stragglers, and resource contention.

Beyond GPU-accelerated training, this work includes partnering with teams building CPU-driven rollout workloads, including tool-use, code execution, and agentic environments, supplying the systems and framework engineering needed to run them efficiently alongside GPU- or LPU-accelerated generation and GPU-accelerated training. It also means advocating for researcher and partner needs with NVIDIA's networking, math library, and compiler teams so the capabilities RL workloads require get prioritized and delivered, and working with hardware teams to take advantage of next-generation hardware capabilities in post-training workloads.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
5+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, high-performance computing, deep learning infrastructure, or ML systems engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++
Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale distributed systems or runtime frameworks in production at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or major technology company
Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries

Depth in one or more of the following technical areas:

Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling), including how algorithms map to distributed execution and the systems challenges they create (heterogeneous placement, rollouts, environment execution, resharding between training and generation)
PyTorch internals, including distributed training primitives (FSDP, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism) and their composition
Kubernetes runtime internals (container lifecycle, pod scheduling, resource quotas, GPU allocation)
End-to-end distributed systems design (service boundaries, data flows, consistency models, failure modes, recovery approaches)

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

Deep expertise in networking (NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand), advanced multi-dimensional parallelisms (Megatron-LM, FSDP2, TP/DP/PP, MoE), or memory optimizations (quantization-aware training, mixed precision)
Experience integrating high-performance inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) into RL training loops for GPU-accelerated rollout
Strong background in actor- and task-based distributed programming (Ray, Monarch, or comparable systems)
Familiarity with multi-turn training, multi-agent co-evolution, or VLM post-training

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Open-source contributions to RL post-training or distributed training projects (e.g., VeRL, Miles, TorchTitan, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, DeepSpeed-Chat), including significant work on framework internals where applicable
Kubernetes work beyond routine operations (custom operators, GPU device plugins, or scheduling contributions)
Direct experience operating frontier-scale training (RL post-training at thousands of GPUs and/or large-scale LLM or multimodal pre-training)
Hands-on experience with production distributed failures at scale (stragglers, resource contention, hardware faults)

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.
